title: Dyadic potential theory and de Rham functions
summary: We study de Rham functional equations driven by two increasing fractional linear transformations. Our main purpose is to relate the singularity theory of the associated solutions to dyadic potential theory on the binary tree. We first prove an existence and uniqueness theorem for increasing, left-continuous solutions in the full range of linear fractional data, and identify the trapping region in parameter space where the solution is continuous.
